newsitem.title: UK: Logica sinks as results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Logica sinks as results disappoint.

text.p: Shares in Logica Plc LOG.L sank on Wednesday after the UK software group disappointed investors with its results, dealers said.
By 1048 GMT, the shares were trading at 920p, down 32-1/2p.
Prior to today's decline, they had jumped 72-1/2p, or more than eight percent, since February 10 leading up to the interim report.
Logica said its pre-tax profits rose 18 percent to 10.6 million in the six months ended December 31.
"They've had a good run.... It's a bit of both -- we're seeing some profit-taking and I think the results were a little disappointing," said one market maker. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
